title: Red neon signs and hospital cross?
content: Just discovered this sub and have been pretty blown away by some of the common elements. I have always been an intense, sometimes lucid dreamer returning to similar places. One thing I haven't yet seen mentioned here - does anybody else often see glowing red neon signs outside their mallworld? Always just capital letters - never full billboards or anything. Also, I often see the same glowing red neon "hospital cross" like a big plus sign somewhere in the distance but it never looks like it's on a building. Usually I see these when my dream turns emotionally uncomfortable or anxious. I never approach the cross or want to to in any of the buildings that have the neon signs. I try to go back inside and avoid them.
